description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class 'PageContentTag' used for inserting dynamic page content based on a content code, retrieving content via a ContentService, and rendering the content within JSP pages.

classes.name: PageContentTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class that retrieves and outputs page content based on a content code, utilizing Spring's dependency injection and request context.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Executes the core logic for fetching content by code and writing it to the JSP output during tag processing.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Defines the cleanup or finalization logic after the tag has been processed; here, it simply indicates page evaluation should continue.
